title: Father with the Drake and Walker and Whitman Sisters shows
summary: His father played for touring black shows through Texas and beyond, territorial dates up to Hot Springs, and was in San Francisco for the earthquake.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Would you know the names of anybody who worked in that band?

I don't think there would be actually anyone that ever actually came out of there to be in the professional world. Of course, that would -- my father, at this time, would be like 97 or 98 years old, so this was an entirely different era that we're speaking of. He used to play the big shows that used to come through like Drake and Walker (PHONETIC) and things of that type, which were -- and the Whitman Sisters shows, that were practically the better line, black shows of that era.
You say they'd come through. You mean, come through where you were living in Texas?

They would come through the different parts of Texas on tour and he would travel with them and go to Galveston or -- which was a big town in those days, you know. There was a whole lot happening in Galveston in those days. And went to St. Louis and Kansas City and went up also, well, into Canada, traveling with those shows in those days.
When you say he had a territory band, it was extra-large piece of territory.

Well, really, speaking of territorial, I was speaking in the lines of the North Texas group and into Oklahoma, then they would also go into Hot Springs, Arkansas, into the spas down there, where the multi-millionaires used to come in those days.
How did he happen to be working as far West as San Francisco?

Well, he just went on a tour, went through Canada and went on across from the eastern part of Canada on over to the western part and came down the West Coast. When he came down, he got to San Francisco, just in time to be in the big earthquake.
And did your mother travel with him frequently?

My mother wasn't with him at that time. That was before her time. He was a bit older than my mother. So, she only started traveling after he came down and resettled again in the area around North Texas, in that area, and that's when he married her.
